# Astering security reporting

This policy applies to [Astering](https://github.com/KanameMadoka520/Astering), which is based on Vikunja. The upstream project is not responsible for receiving or resolving reports about this fork's custom code or deployments.

Use the latest locally published Astering release when checking whether a problem is already fixed. Never include API keys, passwords, authentication cookies, private conversations, database dumps or personal file contents in a public issue.

If this repository's Security tab offers **Report a vulnerability**, use that private reporting feature. If it is not available, open a minimal issue asking the maintainer to establish a private reporting channel, without exploit details or sensitive data. This document does not claim that GitHub private vulnerability reporting, a dedicated security mailbox or a response-time guarantee has been enabled.

Ordinary bugs, deployment questions and translation issues belong in this repository's [issue tracker](https://github.com/KanameMadoka520/Astering/issues). Reports about unmodified upstream code may be coordinated with the upstream maintainers after the affected component and its disclosure requirements have been identified.
